nodes.label: Market Research Brief — lazybull.trade 'Options You Can See'
SEBI statistic: 91-93% of individual F&O traders lose money (₹1.05 lakh crore lost FY25) as the demand hook
nodes.rationale: The most credible, government-sourced hook in Indian fintech; lazybull's product thesis is 'capture the 91% before they fund a broker'.

nodes.label: Open competitive gap: the visual, AI-narrated, learn-by-doing → paper-trade beginner journey nobody owns
nodes.rationale: Analytics tools (OptionStrat, Unusual Whales, Sensibull) visualize for people who already understand; broker education (tastytrade, Varsity) lectures; algo workbenches (Composer, QuantConnect) demand code — lazybull's primer + Bet Builder + AI teacher is the only zero-to-paper-trade visual surface.

nodes.label: AI-as-teacher and conversion engine (real) vs AI-as-oracle (hype to avoid)
nodes.rationale: ~56% direction accuracy marketed as alpha is a liability and SEBI-hostile; the durable moat is the proprietary behavioral data flywheel, and explainability itself is a paid premium feature (Robinhood Cortex $5, Public Premium $10, WarrenAI $14; Public.com reports ~50% of AI conversations led to a transaction in 24h).

nodes.label: Compliance-by-design: paper-only, no signals, lagged India data, hypothetical-performance disclaimers, gamify learning never P&L
nodes.rationale: Paper-only sidesteps broker-dealer registration and SEBI adviser status; '6 agreeing bots is a signal' must be reframed as impersonal hypothetical educational model output; live Yahoo data in India violates SEBI lag norms and Yahoo ToS — compliance is the acquirer's first diligence check and a trust asset.

nodes.label: India as the counter-cyclical, regulation-aligned free beachhead; monetize via brokers, export credibility globally
nodes.rationale: SEBI's crackdown cut options contracts ~83% and pushes retail out of live F&O — live-trading apps shrink under SEBI while an education sim grows; India is the world's largest options market (>84% of global equity-options contracts).
